I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

The source is this channel's own history from 2025-09-03, which Tobias can see because he's a member. Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Later that day she said Southgate had cleared the backlog and closed the incident.

I couldn't find a street address or other site details for Southgate. There are no account files for Tansley that I can see, and GBrain's search is running keyword-only, so its result may be incomplete. I said this in the reply and suggested Tobias ask Priyanka.
